ModMetaData.name: AgentTouchFix
ModMetaData.author: sleepsheep
ModMetaData.description:
Fixes blank build-menu icons in the RimWorld 1.7 Android (Waylith) port, plus touch/input repairs for the port's own gesture layer. No game file is modified; everything is applied at runtime with Harmony.
Icons: the port's Material.mainTexture returns null, so BuildableDef.uiIcon can stay empty, and the CutoutComplexUI icon material can silently discard a whole tile (degenerate _MainTex_ST or a null _MainTex). The mod repairs uiIcon / drops that icon material at draw time, sending the icon through the same plain texture path the icons that already render use.
Logs to files/game/agenttouchfix.log. Switches: files/game/agenttouchfix.iconpath = material (keep the icon material).
